description:
Since childhood, Seo-ah has always been fascinated by love triangles.   

Now that she is an adult, she sometimes imagines, “Would it feel good to do it with three people?”  

But in reality, she has been without a partner for a long time and only comforts herself.   

Then, all of a sudden, two men appear before Seo-ah: Woo-kyung and Doyun.  

Will Seo-ah be able to fulfill the dream she has had since childhood and have a relationship with all three?
